issue.title: Weekly Cargo target sweep guardrail is a silent no-op because cargo-sweep is not installed

task_type_fields.impact:
## Impact

`/mnt/poseidon/cargo-target` — the shared `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` that epic bob-cli-15.4
redirected every Rust build to — has no age-based pruning at all, so it grows without
bound. It is only 754M today, which is why this is not urgent, but the 229G volume was
chosen precisely because the previous unbounded `target/` sprawl reached 125G on `/`.

Proposed by bob-cli-15.7 as a `PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP:` note; filed by the bob-cli-15 land agent.
task_type_fields.repro:
## Repro

```bash
command -v cargo-sweep   # -> not found
```

The weekly guardrail added by epic bob-cli-15.7 guards on that exact check:

```bash
if ! command -v cargo-sweep >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    printf "cargo-sweep not found; skipping Cargo target sweep\n"
    return 0
fi
```

so every weekly run prints the skip message and returns 0. The sibling guardrails in the
same file (`disk_guardrail_docker_prune`, `disk_guardrail_apt_clean`,
`disk_guardrail_uv_cache_prune`) all have their tools installed and do real work.

Either install `cargo-sweep` (`cargo install cargo-sweep`) or replace the call with a
supported target-prune command.

payload.description: Counterpart cleanup: bob-cli-1b removes the pre-redirect per-workspace target/ leftovers that this sweep will never see.
